text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Robert Ruggiero has resigned from the Property Standards Committee effective December 5, 2023. The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel is to appoint its Chair for a term of office for a term of office expiring October 26, 2026, and until a successor is elected.
The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Appointed Afsana Gibson-Chowdhury as the Panel Chair for a term of office expiring October 26, 2026, and until a successor is elected.
